notes:
What's new in 3.6.2:
- Fixed a real problem with location assets: a location could come back as a copy of an earlier one. A mountain street was generated as an airport, and two different landscapes both came back as the same barn. The app was quietly feeding the first two finished locations into every later one as image references, so the model kept redrawing them. Each location is now generated on its own.
- Location assets are now a single frame instead of two views in one image. The second view was invented by the model to fill the space, which is where stray extras like parked buses came from.
